meta.title: Ondra Trust Readings
meta.description: Trust readings for Ondra (L9 extension pool): breaks "how much does she trust you" into five checkable readings — trust, intimacy and familiarity (all from the relationship service ondra-emotion-stage), promise keep-rate (from ondra-memory-prospective), and memory coverage (from ondra-memory-core and ondra-memory-audit). Every reading carries mandatory sources naming the service and field it came from. When a reading cannot be obtained its value is null and its state is unknown, and the missing service is named in the missing list — never substituted with 0, because showing "trust 0%" reads as "she does not trust you at all" when the truth is that the number cannot be computed right now. Read-only projection only: it never invents its own trust score (which would create three competing sources that drift apart), never renders UI (the L8 interface plugins were retired; rendering belongs to the app shell), never writes to any upstream (even adjust is absent from the contract, so the code path does not exist), and never reports percentages or encouragement ("keep it up" turns into a scoring system and invites gaming). The keep-rate denominator counts settled promises only; counting open ones would inflate the ratio and reward procrastination. All five upstreams are soft dependencies: any absence turns just that one reading into unknown while the rest still render.
